mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases consistently over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative, it signals a liquidity trap, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and GDPC1 growth < 0%, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% in one month signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 2% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in one month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) growth is positive and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in one month, it signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth > 0% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
